metadata.name: world-quality-notice
metadata.description: Automatic quality calibration tells the operator which profile it selected

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"world-view\"]');const renderer=root?.getAttribute('data-world-renderer');const quality=document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"world-quality-notice\"]');if(renderer==='3d'&&!quality)throw Error('Automatic quality changed without an operator notice');if(renderer!=='3d'&&renderer!=='2d'&&renderer!=='2d-fallback')throw Error(`Unexpected world renderer: ${renderer}`);return true;})()

metadata.label: Quality notice or explicit renderer capability state
